summary: Allocates a sub-object via a factory/allocation callback at this+0x4 called with (this, 1, 88), stores the returned pointer at this+0x1A4, and initializes its function pointers: CodecModeSelect at obj+0x0, nullsub_4 at obj+0x8, VirtualCallWithIntegerSet at obj+0xC, with obj+0x34 and obj+0x44 zeroed. Then conditionally clamps two bound/dimension fields of the object referenced through this+0x0: when this+0x64 > 4 it writes 54 to obj+0x14 and 4 to obj+0x18 and dispatches a virtual call; when this+0x54 > 256 it writes 56 to obj+0x14 and 256 to obj+0x18 and dispatches a virtual call. Finally calls ImageBufferStrideFill and sub_51E3E7; if this+0x4C == 2 returns the result of VirtualArrayFill instead. Called by sub_516C7B.

operations.description: Invoke factory/allocation function pointer at this+0x4 with (this, 1, 88) and store the returned object pointer at this+0x1A4.
Set obj+0x0 to CodecModeSelect (codec mode function pointer).
If this+0x64 > 4, write 54 to obj+0x14 and 4 to obj+0x18, then dispatch through the object's first vtable entry (*(*a1))(a1).
If this+0x54 > 256, write 56 to obj+0x14 and 256 to obj+0x18, then dispatch through the object's first vtable entry (*(*a1))(a1).
Call ImageBufferStrideFill(this) to fill image-buffer stride state.
Call sub_51E3E7(this) and keep its result as the default return value.
If this+0x4C == 2, call VirtualArrayFill(this) and return its result instead of the default.
Return either the VirtualArrayFill result (when this+0x4C == 2) or the result of sub_51E3E7.
